# Sewa Subida Gardening
> Nepal's most trusted garden design and landscaping studio, serving the Kathmandu Valley since 2009.

## Business
- Founded: 2009 by Ramesh Shrestha in Madhyapur Thimi, Bhaktapur
- Location: Madhyapur Thimi, Bagmati Province, Nepal
- Service area: Kathmandu, Lalitpur, Bhaktapur, Madhyapur Thimi, Pokhara, Chitwan
- Phone: +977 9851-206373
- Email: sewasubidhagardening@gmail.com
- Hours: Sunday–Friday, 7:00 AM – 6:00 PM
- Team: 28 specialists including certified horticulturists, landscape architects, and craftspeople

## Services
- Garden Design & Landscaping: full-concept landscape architecture, 3D visualisation, project management
- Lawn Installation: sodding, seeding, ground preparation — ready in 1–3 days
- Plant Selection & Planting: 200+ varieties, native and drought-resistant species
- Event & Wedding Decor: floral installations for weddings, receptions, corporate events
- Routine Maintenance: weekly, fortnightly, or monthly plans including mowing, pruning, fertilising
- Irrigation & Sprinkler Setup: smart systems with up to 40% water savings

## Credentials
- 840+ completed projects
- 98% client satisfaction
- ISO 9001:2015 certified
- Nepal Horticulture Association member
- SALC Sustainable Landscape Design member
- Nepal Landscaping Excellence Award 2015 (Best Residential Design)
- Best Landscape Studio Nepal 2024 (Nepal Horticulture Association)
